# CHINA URBAN RIDES

## Project
- Subtitle: An atlas of urban passenger transport and change
- Publisher context: public reading-room publication
- Audience: the public, urban research readers and editors
- Publication name: CHINA URBAN RIDES
- Printed descriptor: Counting passenger trips
- National observation periods: January–December 2024; January–December 2025
- Regional observation period: January–December 2024
- Regional selection: Shanghai, Jiangsu, Fujian, Hubei, Guangdong, Chongqing
- Regional administrative level: province-level

## National anchors
| Year | Measure | Value | Unit |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| 2024 | Total | 1067.97 | 100 million passenger trips |
| 2025 | Total | 1043.46 | 100 million passenger trips |
| 2025 | Urban rail | 332.24 | 100 million passenger trips |
| 2025 | Urban rail share | 31.84 | % |
| 2025 | Official total growth | -2.3 | % |
| 2025 | Official Ferry growth | -3.7 | % |

## Mode identity
| Printed mode label | Coverage | Color |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bus | Public buses and trolleybuses operating within cities, including county seats | #E69F00 |
| Urban rail | Urban rail passenger transport | #0072B2 |
| Taxi | Street-hail and ride-hail services operating within cities, including county seats | #CC79A7 |
| Ferry | Urban passenger ferry transport | #009E73 |

## Reading and calculation facts
- Passenger trips: repeatable journey counts; one person can contribute several trips.
- National volume unit: 100 million passenger trips.
- Regional volume unit: 10,000 passenger trips.
- Share unit: % of the reported total for the same year and geographic record.
- Share formula: mode volume / reported total × 100.
- Share precision: two decimal places.
- 2025 official growth basis: comparable statistical scope.
- Annual volume basis: each publication's reported annual values.
- Regional records: two municipalities and four provinces, all at the same administrative level.
- Source credit for 2024 charts: Ministry of Transport | 2024.
- Source credit for 2025 charts: Ministry of Transport | 2025.
- Source credit for two-year charts: Ministry of Transport | 2024–2025.

## Physical carriers
| Carrier | Width | Height | Inner margin |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Landscape display board | 420 mm | 280 mm | 10 mm |
| Portrait leaflet | 200 mm | 300 mm | 10 mm |
| A4 summary | 210 mm | 297 mm | 10 mm |

## Existing location feature
- Object: reading-room window.
- Architecture: three adjacent rounded arches; one circular opening centered above the middle arch.
- Materials: pale limestone surround and dark bronze window frames.
- Identity reference: reading-room-window.png.
- Recurring image: a small vignette retaining the three arches and upper circular opening.

## Sources
- National 2024 records: [Ministry of Transport, 2024 transport industry statistical bulletin](https://xxgk.mot.gov.cn/jigou/zhghs/202506/t20250610_4170228.html), published 2025-06-12.
- National 2025 records: [Ministry of Transport, 2025 transport industry statistical bulletin](https://xxgk.mot.gov.cn/jigou/zhghs/202606/t20260618_4207752.html), published 2026-06-22.
- Regional 2024 records: [Ministry of Transport, 2024 national urban passenger transport table](https://xxgk.mot.gov.cn/jigou/zhghs/202503/t20250326_4165989.html), published 2025-03-26.

# National urban passenger transport

## Source records
| Source ID | Observation period | Publication date | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| N24 | January–December 2024 | 2025-06-12 | [Ministry of Transport, 2024 transport industry statistical bulletin](https://xxgk.mot.gov.cn/jigou/zhghs/202506/t20250610_4170228.html) |
| N25 | January–December 2025 | 2026-06-22 | [Ministry of Transport, 2025 transport industry statistical bulletin](https://xxgk.mot.gov.cn/jigou/zhghs/202606/t20260618_4207752.html) |

## Published annual volumes and growth
- Geographic level: national.
- Volume unit: 100 million passenger trips.
- Growth unit: % against the preceding year.
- 2025 growth: official comparable-basis rates.

| Record ID | Year | Measure | Volume | Official growth % | Source ID |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| N24-T | 2024 | Total | 1067.97 | 5.7 | N24 |
| N24-B | 2024 | Bus | 386.70 | 1.6 | N24 |
| N24-R | 2024 | Urban rail | 322.09 | 9.6 | N24 |
| N24-X | 2024 | Taxi | 358.41 | 7.1 | N24 |
| N24-F | 2024 | Ferry | 0.77 | -6.9 | N24 |
| N25-T | 2025 | Total | 1043.46 | -2.3 | N25 |
| N25-B | 2025 | Bus | 365.66 | -5.5 | N25 |
| N25-R | 2025 | Urban rail | 332.24 | 3.2 | N25 |
| N25-X | 2025 | Taxi | 344.82 | -3.8 | N25 |
| N25-F | 2025 | Ferry | 0.74 | -3.7 | N25 |

## Calculated shares
- Calculation: mode volume / reported national total × 100.
- Inputs: published bulletin values in the preceding table.
- Precision: two decimal places.

| Year | Bus % | Urban rail % | Taxi % | Ferry % |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 2024 | 36.21 | 30.16 | 33.56 | 0.07 |
| 2025 | 35.04 | 31.84 | 33.05 | 0.07 |

## Interpretation records
| ID | Subject | Numerical fact |
| --- | --- | --- |
| I1 | 2025 Bus | Largest of the four mode volumes: 365.66 |
| I2 | 2025 Urban rail | Share: 31.84%; official growth: 3.2% |
| I3 | 2025 Ferry | Volume: 0.74; share: 0.07% |

## Basis notes
- National geographic coverage: the 31 mainland province-level administrative units.
- Taxi coverage: street-hail and ride-hail services.
- Published annual volumes: rounded values from the respective bulletin.
- Official 2025 growth: a separate source field calculated on a comparable basis.
- Annual snapshots and official growth: distinct statistical measures.

# Regional urban passenger transport, 2024

- Original table: [Official annual data table](https://xxgk.mot.gov.cn/jigou/zhghs/202503/P020250326534548574223.pdf).
- Selection: six province-level records with reported volumes for all four modes.
- Volume unit: 10,000 passenger trips.

- Published components and totals: independently rounded source values.
- Share denominator: the reported total.
- Rounded shares: possible sums slightly above or below 100%.
- Geographic meaning: urban passenger activity aggregated within each province-level administrative unit.

# Field definitions and scope

| Field | Definition | Unit or values |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Year | Calendar year of transport activity | 2024; 2025 |
| Region | Province-level administrative unit in the source table | Shanghai; Jiangsu; Fujian; Hubei; Guangdong; Chongqing |
| Total | Reported urban passenger transport total | Passenger trips |
| Bus | Public bus and trolleybus urban passenger transport | Passenger trips |
| Urban rail | Urban rail passenger transport | Passenger trips |
| Taxi | Street-hail and ride-hail urban passenger transport | Passenger trips |
| Ferry | Urban passenger ferry transport | Passenger trips |
| Official growth | Published change against the preceding year | % |
| Share | Mode volume divided by the reported total for the same record | % |

## Counting scope
- Passenger trips: a repeated count of transport use; an individual can contribute multiple observations.
- Urban Bus and Taxi scope: journeys within cities, including county seats.
- Regional hierarchy: provinces and centrally administered municipalities at province level.
- Regional selection size: six administrative units.
- National geography: 31 mainland province-level administrative units.
- Statistical reform effective date: January 2024, as stated in the 2024 annual regional table.
- 2025 official growth basis: comparable scope, as stated in the 2025 bulletin.
- Time comparison in this dataset: 2024 and 2025 national published snapshots alongside official 2025 growth fields.
- Regional comparison in this dataset: 2024 cross-sectional volumes and mode shares.

## Units and calculations
| Calculation | Expression | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| National volume conversion | 1 × 100 million passenger trips | 100000000 passenger trips |
| Regional volume conversion | 1 × 10,000 passenger trips | 10000 passenger trips |
| Regional-to-national unit conversion | 10000 regional units / 10000 | 1 national unit |
| 2025 national Urban rail share | 332.24 / 1043.46 × 100 | 31.84% |
| 2024 Fujian Ferry share | 2545 / 315766 × 100 | 0.81% |
| Arithmetic change from rounded national Ferry volumes | (0.74 / 0.77 - 1) × 100 | -3.9% |
| Official 2025 national Ferry growth | Published comparable-basis field | -3.7% |

- Share rounding: nearest two decimal places.
- Arithmetic Ferry change rounding: nearest one decimal place.
- Difference between the two Ferry calculations: published-volume arithmetic versus the official comparable-basis statistic.
- Growth panels: official growth fields.
- Annual snapshot panels: published annual volume fields.

## Source credits
| Observation coverage | Credit text |
| --- | --- |
| 2024 | Ministry of Transport | 2024 |
| 2025 | Ministry of Transport | 2025 |
| 2024–2025 | Ministry of Transport | 2024–2025 |

- Counting scope and reform date: [Ministry of Transport, 2024 national urban passenger transport table](https://xxgk.mot.gov.cn/jigou/zhghs/202503/P020250326534548574223.pdf).
- Annual rounding and national scope: [Ministry of Transport, 2024 transport industry statistical bulletin](https://xxgk.mot.gov.cn/jigou/zhghs/202506/t20250610_4170228.html).
- Comparable growth and Taxi coverage: [Ministry of Transport, 2025 transport industry statistical bulletin](https://xxgk.mot.gov.cn/jigou/zhghs/202606/t20260618_4207752.html).

steps.userMessage:
CHINA URBAN RIDES | An atlas of urban passenger transport and change

We are commissioning a public reading-room atlas about how urban passenger transport in China is divided between Bus, Urban rail, Taxi and Ferry. The national story covers 2024 and 2025; the regional chapter compares six province-level records from 2024: Shanghai, Jiangsu, Fujian, Hubei, Guangdong and Chongqing. Give readers a clear route between national scale, annual change and regional differences through headings, annotations and page references. Our reading-room window, with three rounded arches and a circular opening above the middle arch, is the recurring location image on every delivered file.

The 2025 national total is 1043.46 in units of 100 million passenger trips; Urban rail accounts for 332.24 and a calculated 31.84% share. Taxi includes street-hail and ride-hail services. Annual volumes and official growth rates occupy separate panels: the Ministry reports 2025 growth on a comparable basis. Print "CHINA URBAN RIDES" and "Counting passenger trips" on every final file. Every chart needs a title, an in-chart unit, a Ministry of Transport credit with the observation year, direct mode labels and one reading annotation. Every printed or plotted data value comes from the attached tables. Use Bus #E69F00, Urban rail #0072B2, Taxi #CC79A7 and Ferry #009E73 with direct labels that remain readable in grayscale. The display board is 420 × 280 mm, the portrait leaflet is 200 × 300 mm and the summary is A4; each has a 10 mm inner margin.

Audience: the public, urban research readers and editors, supporting publication decisions and informed discussion of changes in urban travel.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the project facts, fixed wording and carrier dimensions. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable's proportion, format and stage. 03-national-data.en.md contains 2024–2025 national volumes, official growth rates, calculated shares and sources. 04-regional-data.en.md contains the six 2024 province-level records, calculated shares and source. 05-field-definitions.en.md contains units, geographic scope, formulas and comparability notes. carrier-dimensions.png supplies the three physical page envelopes and margins. reading-room-window.png supplies the existing architectural feature used as the recurring location vignette. mobile-reading-scene.png supplies the atmosphere of a reader moving through a transport story on a phone.

Deliverables:
1. Three reading-direction boards, one each organized by region, by time and by transport mode, each using the 2025 national total and the 2024 Shanghai record
2. One selection note naming the chosen direction and explaining its reading sequence from national overview to regional comparison
3. One data abstract and chart inventory stating every planned chart's data columns, chart type, unit, carrier, printed labels and source credit, with the 2025 total, its unit and source credit as recurring facts
4. One landscape national overview of 2025 and one portrait national story of 2025, each containing the total, four mode volumes and four shares
5. One national change chart with separate 2024 and 2025 volume snapshots and official 2025 growth rates for the total and four modes
6. Two regional comparison charts for 2024: Shanghai, Jiangsu and Fujian on one; Hubei, Guangdong and Chongqing on the other, each with totals, four mode shares and navigation to the national overview
7. Two explanatory pages: one A4 summary with the 2025 total, four shares and three numerical findings; one scope note covering passenger trips, Taxi coverage, province-level geography, the share formula, rounding and comparable growth
8. One 10-second explanatory video reusing the selected national overview to explain the 2025 total and Urban rail share
9. One editorial presentation of at least eight pages, reusing the three directions, selection, data abstract, finished charts, explanatory pages and video frames

Acceptance:
- Present the three reading-direction boards first, name one choice in the selection note, then develop that choice in the data abstract, final charts, explanatory pages, video and presentation; repeat the selected direction's name on the presentation's first page.
- Record 1043.46, 100 million passenger trips and the source credit "Ministry of Transport | 2025" in the data abstract; repeat all three on the national overview, portrait story, A4 summary, video and presentation, with the Urban rail share of 31.84% on those five deliverables.
- Match the national and regional charts, explanatory pages, video and presentation to the attached data tables; give each chart a title, observation year, in-chart unit, source credit, direct mode labels and one reading annotation, using the four fixed mode colors and zero-based volume and share axes.
- Identify both regional charts as 2024 province-level comparisons with their specified groups of three and totals in 10,000 passenger trips; explain multiple trips per person, both Taxi services, the reported-total share denominator and rounding in the scope note, and repeat the scope distinctions on the A4 summary and presentation.
- Separate annual snapshots from official comparable growth on the national change chart, scope note and presentation; retain the official 2025 Ferry rate of -3.7%, give signed growth a visible zero reference, and hold the video's closing total, unit, source and rail share together for its final three seconds.
- Print CHINA URBAN RIDES and Counting passenger trips on every final file, retain the three-arch window vignette on all 14 files, and carry the selected reading sequence through the presentation's minimum eight pages; apply the specified physical dimensions and 10 mm margins to the overview, portrait story and A4 summary.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
